description: What it does: retrieves a finished answer. Call it when: beyond_obvious or invoke returned an id instead of the answer. Retrieve the result of a beyond_obvious (bx_...) or invoke (bo_..., task_..., iv_... or numeric id) request. Polls up to wait_seconds (default 50, max 50). Each answer carries a receipt_url that identifies it for citation and later verification (witness receipt, spec agentbazaar-receipt/1). It is in the result _meta["agentbazaar.receipt"].

id.description: Request id returned by beyond_obvious or invoke

wait_seconds.description: Optional: wait up to this many seconds (0-50, default 50)

name: get_answer
